hard_fail:
Subject: Acme phase 2 status, week of 2 Nov

Hi Meera,

I hope you had a good week. Here is the weekly status update for phase 2 of the Acme rollout, the warehouse module, for the week of 2 November.

What we completed
SSO is now live across all three sites, so your teams at every location now sign in the same way. We have also moved inventory sync from a nightly run to an hourly one, which means stock levels in the system will now be much closer to what is actually on the shelves throughout the day.

What slipped
The barcode scanner integration has moved from 6 November to 13 November. The scanner vendor delivered their firmware later than planned, and we cannot finish the integration without it. We should have flagged this dependency to you earlier, and that is on us. We will confirm by Monday whether the new date of 13 November holds.

Open risk
We are still waiting on VPN access for the Pune site from your IT team. Until we have it, we cannot start work on the Pune setup, and this could affect the timeline for that site. If you could help us nudge this along so we have access by Monday, that would be a big help.

Next week
We will run UAT with your ops team on Tuesday and Wednesday, and we will share a first draft of the training deck by Friday.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
[Name]
